snippet.title: Ocularis - Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
OCULARIS is a first-person puzzle game set in chambers suspended in a void. There's no dialogue and no tutorial text. Each chamber teaches you its rules through what you see and do, and the eye of Ocularis watches as you work out how its world fits together.

Demo coming soon. Wishlist OCULARIS on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4302210/Ocularis/
